source: portfolio_v21_fixed_1.xlsx + Aug-26 THX rebuild (Douta charged at PFS AISC $1,890 not phantom $1,027; Senegal 10% free-carry applied; Segilola AISC rebased $927 -> Q2-26 actual $1,262; Douta capex moved to 2027/28 on FID median Q1-27; 2029 treated as ramp year 45koz) + MTL BACS US$27m equipment facility and discount 12% -> 11%. Income rebuilt on corrected 2029 FCF; NET of NR301 withholding.
income_2029_note: Net of NR301 withholding on the THX CAD dividend (~16.15% effective, not reclaimable in ISA or SIPP). Build: THX FCF/sh GBP 0.3601 x 30% payout x 632,192 sh = 68,305 gross / 57,274 net; MTL FCF/sh GBP 0.0856 x 20% payout x 487,426 sh = 8,344 (UK company, no WHT). Payout ratios are model assumptions (Assumptions H48 / H66), not declared policy. MTL dividend initiation from 2028 is CEO signalling only and sits behind BACS debt service running to Aug 2031 - if MTL pays nothing, 2029 income falls to GBP 57,274 net.

scenario_basis.defect_corrected: Prior block applied a single flat multiple (THX 10x / MTL 6x) to every year and every scenario, capitalising bear cash flow on a base-case re-rating multiple. Symptoms: 2026 bear GBP1.30m (+145% vs the live mark) and 2027 peaking in all three scenarios. The multiple now carries a year and a scenario dimension, and the NPV blend weight escalates by year per Assumptions B105:F109.
scenario_basis.scenario_multiple_note: Asymmetric by design. Bull held at 1.2 not 1.4 because the bull NPV stresses gold only and holds AISC at base (NPV Model row 77), so part of the re-rate is already inside the NPV leg. At 1.4 the multiple accounts for 41% of the base-to-bull delta with no cash-flow support.
open_defects: P/FCF leg is pre-growth-capex: Douta $254m and La India residual $53m are never deducted, so peak-capex years overstate free cash. Requires a per-year net cash/debt bridge.
GBP/USD stale at 1.32 (Assumptions!C8) vs 1.35-1.38 spot. Re-anchoring to 1.38 base / 1.45 bull / 1.28 bear removes a further ~4.5% from base-case GBP values.

Bull pairs $6,000 gold with 4% AISC inflation (Assumptions D18), below the 6% base. A debasement-driven bull implies higher input-cost inflation, not lower. THX royalty step-up 0.88%->3.83% of revenue is ad valorem and absent from the AISC line.
Douta mandatory hedging covenant (30-50% of production) caps participation in the bull case and is unmodelled.
valuation.*.npv_wt and .pfcf_mult still store the 2026 pair only; they drive the dashboard 'lens' string, not this grid.
scenario_basis.caveat: Fundamental valuation floor, not a traded price. At 4.3-5.0x GBP-adjusted gold beta a -18% gold tape marks THX materially below the bear grid.
